variants.specifics: Brackenford: Halvard wants the tithe chest back from Corwin's bandits; Sly Wat sells keys to the watchtower's side door.

offer_a.speaker: Halvard
offer_a.text:
Greetings. So you are the one Ossian spoke of, eh? Well, I could use one more pair of hands, but first you must fetch back the tithe chest Red Corwin's bandits stole.

Will you take on this task?

offer_b.speaker: Sly Wat
offer_b.text:
Hey there, Traveler! Can I interest you in a key to the side door of the old watchtower? These keys are freshly cut and well worth the paltry sum of 50 gold.

Ya want one?

outcome_a.speaker: Halvard
outcome_a.text: Very well! This purse holds your share of the tithe. The shield is from the town armory, which ought to keep Corwin's arrows off you.

outcome_b.speaker: Sly Wat
outcome_b.text:
There you go, I'm sure that key will open the door just fine.

Drop by again if you ever need a spare.

journal_a.text: Recover the tithe chest from Red Corwin's bandits.

journal_b.text: Buy the watchtower key from Sly Wat.

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Warden Krell's bounty on the outlaw Varlo Blackpick, dead or alive. Varlo surrenders if cornered: taken alive, 200 gold from Krell; killed, a steel shield.

offer_a.speaker: Krell
offer_a.text:
Good day, young sir. I presume you have come about the bounty.

There's a fat price on Varlo Blackpick's head -- dead or alive. He and his pack of cutthroats have been robbing our ore carts for a month.

Mind yourself, you don't want to be taken unawares by those vicious dogs.

offer_b.speaker: Varlo Blackpick
offer_b.text: I give up! Don't kill me, please! I'll come along quiet!

outcome_a.speaker: Krell
outcome_a.text:
Hold, there! Foreman Dagrim told me of a racket down in these tunnels, so I came to have a look.

You've taken the infamous Varlo Blackpick all by yourself! Most impressive! You have my deepest respect, young sir! Blackpick's gang has plagued Ostrum for a month! I'll take charge of him now. We'll all rest easier with this rotten villain locked away!

Here's the bounty -- 200 in gold!

outcome_b.speaker: Krell
outcome_b.text:
You killed Varlo, eh? Well, I'd rather have seen him stand trial, but I won't shed a tear for the likes of him!

Here's your reward -- this fine steel shield! Ostrum's tunnels are a safer place thanks to you!

journal_a.text: Bring in Varlo Blackpick for the bounty, dead or alive.

journal_b.text: Bring the captured Varlo Blackpick to Warden Krell.

variants.specifics: Vell: Vasko sells a used sword for Mayor Pellig's Trial of Blades, and Pellig sends entrants to Kessik's forge.

offer_a.speaker: Vasko
offer_a.text:
Now this sword is a real beauty. Its last owner was a little old granny who only used it to slice cheese.

At Kessik's forge a blade like this would cost you 250 gold, easy. But I like the look of you, so I'll part with it for 90. Well, do you want it?

offer_b.speaker: Pellig
offer_b.text: You'll need a sword of your own for the Trial of Blades. Kessik sells them at an honest price.

outcome_a.speaker: Vasko
outcome_a.text: Here ya go! That sword was meant for your hand. Nobody could lose the Trial holding a blade like that.

outcome_b.speaker: Vasko
outcome_b.text: Big mistake, friend. Go on over to Kessik's and look at his swords. Then hurry on back -- there's another fellow asking after this one too.

journal_a.text: Buy a sword for the Trial of Blades.

journal_b.text: Buy a sword at Kessik's forge for the Trial of Blades.

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Quartermaster Ostrick wants the garrison's pay chest back from the Ogres; Nebbick, who drinks in the Rusty Helm, offers to sell the old north tower.

offer_a.speaker: Ostrick
offer_a.text: I'm afraid the men are in a foul mood, with Vargoth's Ogres raiding our supply wagons. They took the garrison's pay chest on the south road. Get it back for me and I'll open the armory to you.

offer_b.speaker: Nebbick
offer_b.text: So, you ready to buy the old north tower and its dungeon? Only 30,000 in gold for the pair of them!

outcome_a.speaker: Ostrick
outcome_a.text: Excellent! You got the pay chest back, lad! Here, take this shield from the armory. I hope you live through this whole business. Now if you'll excuse me, I've got soldiers to pay. Good luck, and keep clear of Vargoth's Ogres if you want to keep your head!

outcome_b.speaker: Nebbick
outcome_b.text: Ah, never mind, friend. I'm sure somebody else will want a tower and a dungeon. Should you reconsider, you know where I'll be!

journal_a.text: Recover the garrison's pay chest from the Ogres for Quartermaster Ostrick.

journal_b.text: Buy the old north tower from Nebbick.

variants.specifics: Tolvin: Fennick the Harbor Master wants a pass sealed by Mayor Gorvane before he lends a boat, and Dobbs, who rowed for Black Varrick, offers a way to get one: fetch the tithe chest he hid in a net shed and take it to the Mayor.

offer_a.speaker: Fennick
offer_a.text: I am the Harbor Master of Tolvin. If you want to take a boat out on the lake you'll need a pass with the Mayor's seal.

offer_b.speaker: Dobbs
offer_b.text:
Hello. Name's Dobbs, I used to row for Black Varrick's crew. Boats are scarce around here, and getting a pass sealed by the Mayor is the hardest part.

Tell you what, you do me a little favor and I'll see that you get your pass. How about it?

outcome_a.speaker: Dobbs
outcome_a.text:
Good! When I quit Varrick's crew I hid the Mayor's tithe chest in the old net shed on the south shore. Trouble is, a nasty little Imp has settled in the shed. He has stirred up the rats and now they bite anyone who goes near it.

Kill the Imp and take the chest back to Mayor Gorvane. Tell him Dobbs kept it safe for him, and he'll seal your pass!

Here, take this iron key, it opens the shed.

outcome_b.speaker: Dobbs
outcome_b.text:
Suit yourself, I doubt the Mayor will seal a pass for a stranger.

Should you think better of it, I'll be at the Bent Hook, in the back.

journal_a.text: Get a boat pass sealed by Mayor Gorvane.

journal_b.text: Take the tithe chest from the net shed to Mayor Gorvane.

variants.specifics: Olvane: Ursin, the registrar, enters candidates for the College's Golem Trial. Fennick sells a sword for it in the Brass Owl.

offer_a.speaker: Ursin
offer_a.text:
Are you entering the Golem Trial? Then you must bring your own sword and pay 25 gold to enter. We provide the Golem.

Well? Shall I write you down or not?

offer_b.speaker: Fennick
offer_b.text:
Here for the Golem Trial, I bet. I've got a lovely sword for sale.

Seeing as you have an honest face, I'll let you have it for 100 gold. Are you interested?

outcome_a.speaker: Ursin
outcome_a.text: Right. Everything seems to be in order. In you go. The judge will go over the rules with you. Good luck.

outcome_b.speaker: Fennick
outcome_b.text: There ya go! That blade was made for your hand. No Golem stands a chance against a sword like that.

journal_a.text: Enter the Golem Trial at the College.

journal_b.text: Buy Fennick's sword before the Golem Trial.

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Brisa begs for her husband Pell, taken by the Trolls from the woodcutters' camp. Tibbet needs his uncle Gorm's lucky helm back from the Trolls before Gorm gets home.

offer_a.speaker: Brisa
offer_a.text:
Kind sir! Please help me! A band of Kragan's Trolls just raided the woodcutters' camp, the camp below the fort and carried off nearly every cutter! One of them is my dear husband, Pell!

Please bring him home and I swear you'll be rewarded!

offer_b.speaker: Tibbet
offer_b.text:
The Trolls just made off with my uncle's lucky helm! If it isn't back by tonight, he'll have my hide. He's due home off the wall any time now!

Please, help me, young sir! I think the Trolls who grabbed it went to the old chapel.

Would you... could you fetch it back for me?

outcome_a.speaker: Brisa
outcome_a.text: Oh, bless you, brave Adventurer! Please take these as tokens of my gratitude!

outcome_b.speaker: Tibbet
outcome_b.text: Phew! Thanks a lot! Here, take this as a token of my appreciation!

journal_a.text: Rescue Pell and the woodcutters from Kragan's Trolls.

journal_b.text: Recover Gorm's lucky helm from the Trolls at the old chapel.

variants.specifics: Orvak: Warden Holgarth offers a bounty on the outlaw Vesk Blackthumb, and Fenwick the armour dealer, robbed by Vesk's cutthroats, will reward whoever stops them.

offer_a.speaker: Warden Holgarth
offer_a.text:
Good day, young sir. I presume you've come about the bounty.

There's a fat purse waiting for whoever brings in Vesk Blackthumb -- dead or alive. He and his miserable gang of cutthroats have been robbing our ore wagons for a month now.

Watch yourself. You don't want those vicious brutes sneaking up on you.

offer_b.speaker: Fenwick
offer_b.text:
To tell the truth, trade has been rather poor lately. Last month, cutthroats smashed in my door and emptied the shop.

I doubt I'll ever see my goods again, but I'd dearly love to see those villains punished.

I'll gladly reward anyone who puts a stop to them.

outcome_a.speaker: Warden Holgarth
outcome_a.text:
Vesk is dead, eh? Well, I'd hoped to see him hang, but I won't shed a tear over that scoundrel!

Here's your reward -- 150 in gold! Orvak owes you a great debt!

outcome_b.speaker: Fenwick
outcome_b.text:
So those cutthroats finally got what they deserved! Well done, lad! We'll all rest easier knowing those villains won't be getting their grubby hands on our goods again!

And here's your reward... my finest steel shield! You're always welcome at Fenwick's!

journal_a.text: Hunt down Vesk Blackthumb and collect the Warden's bounty.

journal_b.text: Bring the thieves who robbed Fenwick's shop to justice.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: Women of Torvel Cross kidnapped in an Ogre raid and held in the pens of Fort Ulm: Ysolde asks to be led home, sharp-tongued Grizzel asks again and sulks at a no.

offer_a.speaker: Ysolde
offer_a.text:
Hail, brave Adventurer! We are honest women, snatched from Torvel Cross in a vicious Ogre raid!

Will you please lead us safely home? If you do, I'm sure a fine reward will be yours, since the men of Torvel Cross can't even cook their own supper without us!

offer_b.speaker: Grizzel
offer_b.text: Oh, it's you again. Have you thought it over? Will you be our hero and take us home?

outcome_a.speaker: Ysolde
outcome_a.text:
Then it's agreed! We'll follow you home!

We have to be quick. Time is short!

The Ogres barred the door of this pen, but I heard one of those smelly Ogre cooks talk about a hole behind the woodpile. If we poke around here, perhaps we can find it!

outcome_b.speaker: Grizzel
outcome_b.text: Well, that's a shame. I hope you think it over soon, for I fear it's nearly supper time. I heard the big one sharpening his cleaver a little while ago.

journal_a.text: Lead the kidnapped women out of the Ogre pens in Fort Ulm.

journal_b.text: NOTE: The Ogres have barred the way out. Search the pens for another way.

variants.specifics: Corvale: Sergeant Krell sells a sword lesson for 100 gold; Muddock wants a rope pulled by the barn door on his signal.

offer_a.speaker: Sergeant Krell
offer_a.text: Ready for your lesson in swordplay? That will be 100 gold for the sword you'll train with.

offer_b.speaker: Muddock
offer_b.text:
Hello, stranger. Could you pull that rope by the barn door when I wave my hat? I'd be ever so grateful.

Just let me climb up into the hayloft first.

outcome_a.speaker: Sergeant Krell
outcome_a.text: Hmmm, pity. Swordplay isn't for everyone.

outcome_b.speaker: Muddock
outcome_b.text: It worked! It actually worked! Thank you! You must be my lucky star!

journal_a.text: Pay Sergeant Krell for a lesson in swordplay.

journal_b.text: Pull the barn rope when Muddock gives the signal.
